ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Core DLL Loaded By Non PowerShell Process
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects loading of essential DLLs used by PowerShell by non-PowerShell process.
Detects behavior similar to meterpreter's "load powershell" extension.
 Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_description = "System\.Management\.Automation" OR process_original_file_name = "System\.Management\.Automation\.dll" OR (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\System\\\.Management\\\.Automation\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\System\\\.Management\\\.Automation\\\.ni\\\.dll$"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\dsac\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\System32\\\\RemoteFXvGPUDisablement\\\.exe$") OR
